identity: A B/G domain-ramp midrange deck that treats its manabase as a scaling term. Deathbloom Gardener, Slimefoot's Survey and 18 lands power out mana value 6-7 bodies, while Eerie Soultender, Shadow Prophecy, a kicked Urborg Lhurgoyf and Uurg's upkeep surveil stock the graveyard alongside them. From there the fat reaches the battlefield by whichever route is open: hard-cast it, return it with Sheoldred's Restoration (Mossbeard Ancient's 'When this creature enters, you gain 5 life' refunds 5 of the 7 life the unkicked spell charges, so a 7/7 trample costs a net 2 life), put it back with The Cruelty of Gix chapter III, which has no mana-value cap, or return the cheap half with Bortuk Bonerattle's domain clause. Monstrous War-Leech reads the same graveyard off the cast side, so the plan survives every reanimation spell being answered. The manabase is built to raise the basic-land-type count that Bortuk, Shadow Prophecy, Slimefoot's Survey and sideboard Drag to the Bottom all read - but that count is a distribution, not a constant, and the deck is built to function at its MODAL three types rather than its ceiling of four.

restrictions.extra_user_constraint: At most 5 rare-or-mythic cards total across mainboard + sideboard (rare LANDS count).

mainboard.name: Sheoldred's Restoration
mainboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {2}{W} (You may pay an additional {2}{W} as you cast this spell.)
Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. If this spell was kicked, you gain life equal to that card's mana value. Otherwise, you lose that much life.
Exile Sheoldred's Restoration.

mainboard.name: The Cruelty of Gix
mainboard.oracle_text:
Read ahead (Choose a chapter and start with that many lore counters. Add one after your draw step. Skipped chapters don't trigger. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a creature or planeswalker card from it. That player discards that card.
II — Search your library for a card, put that card into your hand, then shuffle. You lose 3 life.
III — Put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.

mainboard.name: Eerie Soultender
mainboard.oracle_text:
When this creature enters, mill three cards. (Put the top three cards of your library into your graveyard.)
{4}{B}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Return another target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.

mainboard.name: Shadow Prophecy
mainboard.oracle_text: Domain — Look at the top X cards of your library, where X is the number of basic land types among lands you control. Put up to two of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard. You lose 2 life.

mainboard.name: Uurg, Spawn of Turg
mainboard.oracle_text:
Uurg's power is equal to the number of land cards in your graveyard.
At the beginning of your upkeep, surveil 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put that card into your graveyard.)
{B}{G}, Sacrifice a land: You gain 2 life.

mainboard.name: Deathbloom Gardener
mainboard.oracle_text:
Deathtouch
{T}: Add one mana of any color.

mainboard.name: Slimefoot's Survey
mainboard.oracle_text: Domain — Search your library for up to two land cards that each have a basic land type, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. Look at the top X cards of your library, where X is the number of basic land types among lands you control. Put up to one of them on top of your library and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

mainboard.name: Bortuk Bonerattle
mainboard.oracle_text: Domain — When Bortuk Bonerattle enters, if you cast it, choose target creature card in your graveyard. Return that card to the battlefield if its mana value is less than or equal to the number of basic land types among lands you control. Otherwise, put it into your hand.

mainboard.name: Mossbeard Ancient
mainboard.oracle_text:
Trample
When this creature enters, you gain 5 life.

mainboard.name: Monstrous War-Leech
mainboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {U} (You may pay an additional {U} as you cast this spell.)
As this creature enters, if it was kicked, mill four cards. (To mill a card, put the top card of your library into your graveyard.)
Monstrous War-Leech's power and toughness are each equal to the greatest mana value among cards in your graveyard.

mainboard.name: Urborg Lhurgoyf
mainboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {U} and/or {B} (You may pay an additional {U} and/or {B} as you cast this spell.)
As this creature enters, mill three cards for each time it was kicked.
Urborg Lhurgoyf's power is equal to the number of creature cards in your graveyard and its toughness is equal to that number plus 1.

mainboard.name: Cut Down
mainboard.oracle_text: Destroy target creature with total power and toughness 5 or less.

mainboard.name: Tear Asunder
mainboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {1}{B} (You may pay an additional {1}{B} as you cast this spell.)
Exile target artifact or enchantment. If this spell was kicked, exile target nonland permanent instead.

mainboard.name: Bone Splinters
mainboard.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature.
Destroy target creature.

mainboard.name: Haunted Mire
mainboard.oracle_text:
({T}: Add {B} or {G}.)
This land enters tapped.

mainboard.name: Sunlit Marsh
mainboard.oracle_text:
({T}: Add {W} or {B}.)
This land enters tapped.

mainboard.name: Contaminated Aquifer
mainboard.oracle_text:
({T}: Add {U} or {B}.)
This land enters tapped.

mainboard.name: Tangled Islet
mainboard.oracle_text:
({T}: Add {G} or {U}.)
This land enters tapped.

mainboard.name: Radiant Grove
mainboard.oracle_text:
({T}: Add {G} or {W}.)
This land enters tapped.

sideboard.name: Broken Wings
sideboard.oracle_text: Destroy target artifact, enchantment, or creature with flying.
sideboard.when_to_board: Answers three cube threat classes with one card — 'Destroy target artifact, enchantment, or creature with flying' covers 15 artifacts, 18 enchantments and the flying half of the 51-card evasion class.

sideboard.name: Magnigoth Sentry
sideboard.oracle_text: Reach (This creature can block creatures with flying.)
sideboard.when_to_board: A 4/4 for 4 whose entire oracle text is 'Reach' — it BLOCKS the cube's 51-card evasion class rather than killing it, and it is the slot where the mainboard's accepted 'raced' weakness gets reversed.

sideboard.name: Choking Miasma
sideboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {G} (You may pay an additional {G} as you cast this spell.)
If this spell was kicked, put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
All creatures get -2/-2 until end of turn.
sideboard.when_to_board: Against wide token boards (Tokens is the cube's 2nd-largest cluster at 38 cards). 'All creatures get -2/-2 until end of turn' — of this deck's own creatures it kills Deathbloom Gardener and Eerie Soultender x2, so board those out; Uurg, Bortuk and Mossbeard Ancient all survive.

sideboard.name: Nemata, Primeval Warden
sideboard.oracle_text:
Reach
If a creature an opponent controls would die, exile it instead. When you do, create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.
{G}, Sacrifice a Saproling: Nemata gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
{1}{B}, Sacrifice two Saprolings: Draw a card.
sideboard.when_to_board: PROPHYLAXIS against the cube's 32 graveyard-interaction cards, not an answer to a stocked yard: 'If a creature an opponent controls would die, exile it instead' is a replacement effect on FUTURE deaths, so board it in before an opposing graveyard deck fills up, not after. It does not touch this deck's own graveyard.

sideboard.name: Drag to the Bottom
sideboard.oracle_text: Domain — Each creature gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is 1 plus the number of basic land types among lands you control.
sideboard.when_to_board: Against go-wide decks. 'Each creature gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is 1 plus the number of basic land types among lands you control' — realistically -4/-4 at this manabase's modal three types and -5/-5 at four; Mossbeard Ancient survives either, Bortuk and Uurg do not.

sideboard.name: Bite Down
sideboard.oracle_text: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature or planeswalker you don't control.
sideboard.when_to_board: Against decks with a single large threat — 'Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature or planeswalker you don't control' turns a resolved 7/7 Mossbeard Ancient into repeatable removal at no card cost.

identity_es: Un midrange de aceleración domain B/G que trata su base de maná como un término de escala. Deathbloom Gardener, Slimefoot's Survey y 18 tierras despliegan cuerpos de valor de maná 6-7, mientras Eerie Soultender, Shadow Prophecy, un Urborg Lhurgoyf kickeado y el surveil de mantenimiento de Uurg abastecen el cementerio en paralelo. Desde ahí los gordos llegan al campo de batalla por la ruta que esté abierta: lanzarlo a coste normal, devolverlo con Sheoldred's Restoration (el 'When this creature enters, you gain 5 life' de Mossbeard Ancient reembolsa 5 de las 7 vidas que cobra el hechizo sin kicker, así que un 7/7 con arrollar cuesta netas 2 vidas), reponerlo con el capítulo III de The Cruelty of Gix, que no tiene límite de valor de maná, o devolver la mitad barata con la cláusula de domain de Bortuk Bonerattle. Monstrous War-Leech lee ese mismo cementerio desde el lado del lanzamiento, así que el plan sobrevive a que respondan a todos los hechizos de reanimación. La base de maná está construida para subir el recuento de tipos de tierra básica que leen Bortuk, Shadow Prophecy, Slimefoot's Survey y el Drag to the Bottom del banquillo; pero ese recuento es una distribución y no una constante, y el mazo está construido para funcionar en sus tres tipos MODALES y no en su techo de cuatro.
